name: Graph, Retrieval Bench, and Curriculum Evidence
area: Owns graph persistence, retrieval evidence, retrieval benchmark parity, and curriculum-evidence bugs.
audit_basis: Matched queued BUG IDs against regression tests in tests/test_bug*.py.
Included previously merged no-op or patch-only lineage already applied in this workspace thread for BUG-013, BUG-124, BUG-135, and BUG-138.

items.title: `save_graph()` truncates `node_id`, so distinct long node identities can collide and merge on reload
20,000-passage cap can be exhausted by filler sources before target content loads
Hard no-overlap chunk splitting breaks retrieval at passage boundaries
Retrieval and evaluation can certify snippets whose shown excerpt omits the actual matching evidence
`retrieval_eval_bench.py` does not validate benchmark-case field types and can false-pass or crash on malformed rows
